description: This PHP source file defines the TaskRepository class, which interacts with a MySQL database to perform CRUD operations and queries related to Task entities within a project management system. It includes methods for finding, cloning, searching, updating, inserting, and deleting tasks, as well as constructing complex SQL queries with joins to related tables.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing database access and operations for Task entities, extending MysqlRepository and implementing Findable interface.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieve all tasks, optionally excluding template tasks and limiting the number of results.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Create a clone of an existing task for a user, copying relevant columns.

methods.name: findByKeywords
methods.description: Search for tasks matching keywords in summary or description.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Find tasks associated with a specific project ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Perform a search based on provided SearchCriteria and optional pagination.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base SelectQueryBuilder with joins and default columns.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Find a task by its ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Delete a task by its ID.

methods.name: deleteByIds
methods.description: Delete multiple tasks by an array of IDs.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Update a task's columns by ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert a new task into the database.
